commits.summary: Add the private archive of original outputs: spool, journal, verified upload, list and fetch
Seal each verification run's originals before the pipeline cuts or removes them (shadow mode)
Inventory and protect what exists only on this VM; upload sealed originals in parallel
Add sync.py checkpoint: one committed revision to origin's develop, forward only, with outgoing-object checks
Seal source transcripts at each sync; reproduce example 359's native-selector route from hydrated evidence
Cut the entry points over to checkpoints: the default run belongs to a promotion, not to a landing
Record the design of sync.py promote for the next cycle
Add sync.py promote: a frozen part of develop becomes main, with its logs, originals and test receipt accounted for
Checkpoint: a credential fixture the remote already holds is not refused again when its file is edited
Add delegated redaction decisions, switched off: a person can let one run's watcher decide routine findings
